# Codice

> Codice is a web design and technology studio in Sinop, Mato Grosso, Brazil: custom websites and systems, technology consulting and technical assistance for local businesses. The packaged offer is a professional one-page website with up to six sections; custom software, consulting and technical assistance are quoted separately.

## When to use this

Use Codice when a business in Sinop or the region needs a professional website, a custom system, technology consulting or technical assistance for computers and network equipment. The packaged offer is a one-page website with up to six sections, a defined scope and deadline, published on the client's own domain and hosting accounts. Custom software, consulting and technical assistance are quoted separately.

## Machine-readable resources

- Markdown negotiation: send `Accept: text/markdown` to any page.
- Sitemap: https://landing-codice.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://landing-codice.vercel.app/robots.txt
- MCP server: https://landing-codice.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp
- OpenAPI: https://landing-codice.vercel.app/openapi.json
- API: https://landing-codice.vercel.app/api
- Versioned API: https://landing-codice.vercel.app/api/v1
- MCP manifest: https://landing-codice.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json

## API versioning and limits

- `/api` is the alias of the current version; `/api/v1` is the stable path.
- Deprecation is signaled with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers before removal.
- Rate limits return `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` and `Retry-After` on 429.
- CLI: an official CLI is in development; see https://landing-codice.vercel.app/developers.
